newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-IRELAND HELD BY ICELAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IRELAND HELD BY ICELAND.

text.p: Ireland's World Cup hopes suffered a setback on Sunday when unfancied Iceland held them 0-0.
The nearest Ireland came to scoring was in the 21st minute when striker Tony Cascarino headed just wide following a corner from midfielder Andy Townsend on the right.
Defence-minded Iceland's best chance fell to striker Helgi Sigurdsson in the 63rd minute. He was sent clear down the right by Heimir Gudjonsson but his shot was well saved by goalkeeper Alan Kelly.
The result left Ireland second behind Macedonia on goal difference in group eight. Iceland have only Liechtenstein below them.

Ireland: 1-Alan Kelly; 5-Gary Breen, 6-Roy Keane, 4-Phil Babb; 2-Jeff Kenna (13-Kenny Cunnigham 64), 10-Jason McAteer, 8-Alan McLoughlin, 7-Andy Townsend (captain), 3-Denis Irwin (12- Ian Harte 64); 9-David Kelly (15-Alan Moore 80), 11-Tony Cascarino.
